title: ProcureSettle PO line inputs
description: Line items supplied to create_po, mirroring the contract's LineInput struct. The array must hold between 1 and MAX_LINES (8) entries, and each line_id must be unique because the contract rejects duplicate line IDs.

line_id.description: Caller-assigned line identifier, unique within the PO.

ordered_quantity.description: Whole quantity units ordered on this line.

unit_price.description: Positive token base units charged per whole quantity unit.
